title: Dragonwrath and the Blue Flight
summary: Malygos’s death leaves the Blue Dragonflight divided, while Anachronos’s warning draws mortals toward Dragonwrath and the danger near the Nexus.
opening: The blue dragons faced a choice of leadership while a darker influence moved near the Nexus. A mortal's search for Dragonwrath became entangled with that decision.
reviewNote: The preview establishes the setup. Verify the Embrace's result and Tarecgosa's fate in released quest text. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Set out the division between Kalecgos and Arygos. Investigate the threat he detects near the Nexus. Follow Tarecgosa and the quest through the Firelands. Review the Embrace and the lasting cost of the choice.

chapters.title: After Malygos
chapters.body: After Malygos’s death, Kalecgos and Arygos stood within a divided Blue Dragonflight. The choice of a new leader carried an inheritance marked by grief.

chapters.title: Anachronos's warning
chapters.body: Anachronos warned of a danger near the Nexus. The flight’s choice now stood beneath a darker influence.

chapters.title: The road to Dragonwrath
chapters.body: Tarecgosa and a mortal seeker became bound to the search for Dragonwrath. Their road reached toward the Firelands.

chapters.title: A flight chooses
chapters.body: The Embrace approached with a choice for the blue dragons. Its lasting cost remains to be recovered within this unfinished account.
